svg.title: FoveaWAM Fig. 2 concept v6
svg.desc: FoveaWAM method architecture (concept v6). (a) Training view: current RGB-D patches with XYZ and 3D RoPE, target SE(3) history and robot history form scene tokens S; 16 learned summary tokens M and 8 noisy action tokens A share masked self-attention with separate world and action FFNs over 24 layers. Training-only linear heads read sparse 3D scene flow from patch states and the target SE(3) trajectory from mean(M); a velocity head reads A. (b) Attention mask S->S, M->S,M, A->S,M,A. (c) Inference: the world stream runs once, its keys and values are cached, and the action stream integrates 5 Euler steps; forecast heads are skipped.

g.text: · shared Q, K, V, O over both streams
The world stream never reads A or u
A reads S and M in every layer
